theme.movedBefore: Themes and airline logos live on the

unitSource.label: Weight unit source
unitSource.hint: App = the unit below; Aircraft = follow ProSim's weight unit

unit.label: Weight unit
unit.hint: Display only; values are stored in kg

splitFlap.label: Split-flap animation
splitFlap.hint: Animate the header displays; off snaps characters instantly

loadsheets.title: Loadsheets

prelimOnRefuel.label: Preliminary loadsheet when refuel starts
prelimOnRefuel.hint: Generate and send the prelim as GSX refueling begins

prelimAtStd.label: Preliminary loadsheet before departure time
prelimAtStd.hint: Also send the prelim at STD minus the offset below

finalDelay.label: Final loadsheet delay
finalDelay.hint: Random dispatcher delay before the final goes out

syncFms.label: Send final figures to the MCDU
syncFms.hint: Push ZFW, ZFWCG and block fuel into INIT B when the final is produced

loadsheets.lmcHint: The boarded load against the final loadsheet when boarding completes

lmc.label: Last-minute change check
lmc.hint: Within the tolerances the FO reads the change and an LMC block stands under the final; beyond them the captain is asked for a revised final.
lmc.more: Only when a final loadsheet already exists when boarding completes. "Last minute change" by voice or the Loadsheet page button checks at any time.

lmcMaxPax.label: Max passenger difference
lmcMaxPax.hint: Beyond this a revised loadsheet is required.

lmcAutoRevise.label: Revise without asking
lmcAutoRevise.hint: Beyond tolerance, issue the revised final straight away.

aircraftLimits.title: Aircraft limits
aircraftLimits.hint: Wind limits for the Takeoff and Landing pages, the briefings and the FO's wind check
aircraftLimits.demonstrated: Defaults are the A320 published demonstrated values (38 kt crosswind gust included, 15 kt tailwind, 33 kt on a wet runway) and a common RWYCC table. Operators restrict them further — edit to your own.

fuelDecision.title: Fuel decision
fuelDecision.hint: The captain's extra-fuel advice at dispatch and the holding time in flight

advice.label: Fuel decision at dispatch
advice.hint: After the OFP import the FO reads the destination TAF at the ETA and asks "take it?" when holding fuel is advised.
advice.more: Yes raises the INIT block fuel by the figure, rounded up to 100 kg; the refuel target follows. Off: "fuel decision" on request only. Advice, never a block.

holdingBurn.label: Holding burn
holdingBurn.hint: A320 holding fuel flow behind every minutes ↔ kilos figure.

marginalMinutes.label: Holding for marginal weather
marginalMinutes.hint: Ceiling within 500 ft or visibility within 1000 m of the minima.

flightStatus.title: Flight Status card
flightStatus.hint: Weather cards, the gate monitor and the flight progress figures

finalCallPax.label: Final call at passengers on board
finalCallPax.hint: The gate monitor shows FINAL CALL once this share of the planned passengers has boarded; 100 = off

finalCallStd.label: Final call before departure time
finalCallStd.hint: Also FINAL CALL this many minutes before STD (OFP, or the Loadsheet page entry); 0 = off

weatherRefresh.label: Weather card refresh
weatherRefresh.hint: How often the local / destination weather cards re-read the METAR; they also refresh on every OFP fetch

todNotice.label: Top of descent notice
todNotice.hint: How long before the estimated top of descent the app records the 'top of descent approaching' moment, once per flight; 0 = off. The estimate uses the 3:1 rule on the direct distance to the destination

tileLayout.label: Tile layout
tileLayout.hint: The order of the tiles on the Flight Status page. Change it there with Edit layout (drag a tile by its grip, or use the arrows); it is saved for every device. Reset puts the default order back.

restart.title: After a restart in flight
restart.hint: The leg's state is kept in a file and taken back when the app starts again inside the same flight

remember.label: Remember the flight across a restart
remember.hint: Keeps the OFP, block and flight times, fuel log, minima, chrono and the once-per-flight latches; restored only when the aircraft and the EFB still match the saved flight. Nothing is written to the EFB on restore

maxAge.label: Ignore a saved flight older than
maxAge.hint: A saved flight older than this is dropped at startup — the flight it belonged to is over

manualTicks.label: Allow manual ticks
manualTicks.hint: Hand-tick auto-detected items on the Checklists page
